commuting_groups.description: Partition of term indices (0-based) into qubitwise-commuting measurement groups. Each inner array sorted ascending. Use a minimum number of groups.

optimal_scale_factors.description: Selected noise scale factors for Richardson extrapolation, sorted ascending. Must be a subset of allowed_scale_factors with size in [min_extrapolation_points, max_extrapolation_points].

richardson_coefficients.description: Lagrange interpolation coefficients for extrapolation to lambda=0, in the same order as optimal_scale_factors. gamma_j = prod_{k!=j} (-x_k) / (x_j - x_k).

minimum_variance.description: Minimum total estimation variance of the Hamiltonian expectation value achievable with optimal shot allocation for the selected scale factors and commuting groups.

shot_allocation.description: shot_allocation[g][j] = number of shots allocated to measurement group g at scale factor j. Dimensions: [num_groups x num_scale_factors]. Must sum to total_shot_budget.
